LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_Trait.degreeDatas.0.label: Extradimensional Burner
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_Trait.degreeDatas.0.descript: Mingyuan burns her material body to release life energy at impossible speed. In battle the flame is fierce and unrestrained; in quiet hours it leaves her watchful, restrained, and unable to stop seeking strength.
